basic_info.description: First time on the market since it was built in 1997! Cute and warm Semi-detached single-family home nestled in San Francisco's desirable Ingleside neighborhood. This beautifully maintained residence offers a blend of classic character and modern updates, providing both comfort and style. With 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom on the top floor, Downstairs has a legal 2 bedroom and 1 full bathroom on the ground floor. Newly updated bathrooms, new flooring entire house, new water heater and fresh paint interior and exterior. Step outside to discover a level and flat back yard. Just minutes from Balboa Park BART station and with easy access to I-280, this home is a commuter's dream. Set in the vibrant Ingleside community, it's surrounded by Ocean Avenue's diverse shops, cafes, and dining options, nearby parks and highly rated schools including SF State University and City College of San Francisco, making this an ideal choice for anyone looking for a lively, convenient San Francisco neighborhood.
